name: CI Games S.A.
summary: CI Games S.A. produces, publishes, and distributes video games in Europe, North and South America, Asia, and Africa. The company primarily publishes own and licensed first-person shooter games for various platforms, such as PlayStation, Xbox platforms, and PCs. It sells games directly to retail chains; and online through digital distribution channels, including Steam, PlayStation Store, Xbox Games Store, App Store, and Google Store. The company was formerly known as City Interactive S.A. and changed its name to CI Games S.A. in August 2013. CI Games S.A. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.
